headline: Global regulators unite in Sydney to tackle AI-driven harms and expand international network
summary: On 25 November 2026 the eSafety Commissioner published a release on meetings in Sydney of the Global Online Safety Regulators Network (GOSRN). Members endorsed a joint position statement on preventing the creation and spread of AI-generated child sexual abuse material and non-consensual intimate imagery, calling for greater accountability from technology companies, stronger safeguards in AI systems and coordinated regulatory action. The release does not announce a binding instrument, bill, act or statutory code.
